title: Split the Limit: Algebra of Limits Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
The limit of (x^2 + 3x)(x - 1)/(x + 2) as x tends to 2 looks scary. Creeping up on 2 with a table would take ages. Like cleaning a bicycle chain link by link, we can break the limit into small pieces. In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 12, Limits and Derivatives) we learn the algebra of limits.

You will meet the two building blocks, then watch f(x) = x^2 + 3x and g(x) = x + 2 close in on 10 and 4 live, while f + g, f times g and f over g close in on 14, 40 and 2.5. We state the NCERT theorem for sums, differences, products, quotients and a constant in front, see exactly when the quotient rule is switched off, and crack the scary limit in five small steps. Then a worked example, the exam trap about 0/0, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
